creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-10-07: 'muster tab rename t29vgmaqym CHAT NOTES' (meaning: rename that tab) renamed the tab the window's keyboard was in - another session's tab - to 't29vgmaqym CHAT NOTES', because NAME is variadic and the tab is --tab. Nothing said so, and the other session noticed only later. A first word that is a live tab's id (or a pane's) is almost certainly meant as the target: refuse it with the --tab spelling, or take it as the tab. pane rename is worth the same check.
title: tab rename with a tab id as its first word renames the keyboard's tab to the id
